verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an embeddable on-ramp widget (modal or in-app web view, customizable, with pre-fill) and a headless Web SDK and API path with quotes, card, Apple Pay and Google Pay frames. It also offers PCI-hosted card capture, sandbox/test mode and demo integrations. Bank transfers are claimed on the consumer site, and the enterprise page describes converting incoming fiat bank transfers into stablecoins via API. Missing for 10: the developer docs never explicitly confirm stablecoin assets or bank-transfer payment in the embedded widget/SDK flow, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the integration.
